channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Rubio Reassures Zelenskyy Of US Commitment, But Warns Of 'Hard' Concessions
item.description: On his second day at the Munich Security Conference, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio set out to calm nerves and sharpen focus: Ukraine and security, he signaled, very much remain the center of gravity of Washington’s transatlantic policy.

item.title: Rubio Stresses Diplomacy On Iran Nuclear Issue, Says Trump Prefers Talks Over Strikes
item.description: Iran has opened the possibility of striking a deal over its nuclear program with the United States provided that Washington lift its sanctions imposed on the regime.

item.title: From Central Europe, Rubio Rejects NATO Exit Talk, Calls For Stronger European Role
item.description: Just one day after addressing the Munich Security Conference, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio used a brief stop in the Slovak capital to dispel fears of a US retreat from NATO, telling reporters that Washington remains firmly committed to the alliance.

item.title: Former Ukrainian Energy Minister Detained At Border, Charged With Money Laundering
item.description: Ukraine's former energy minister has been charged with money laundering a day after he was detained trying to leave the country.

item.title: Navalny's Mother Demands Justice As Supporters Mark Anniversary Of His Death
item.description: Dozens gathered at a Moscow cemetery on the second anniversary of Aleksei Navalny's death, laying flowers at his grave, as European countries said Russia poisoned Navalny with exotic frog toxin.

item.title: Iran Tests Economic Pitch To Entice Trump Into Deal
item.description: As Iran and the United States prepare for a new round of nuclear talks, Tehran has signaled it is ready to open key sectors to US investment to secure a lasting agreement. Whether that will be enough to sway President Trump, however, remains uncertain.

item.title: US, Iranian Officials Set For New Negotiations Aimed At Preventing War
item.description: US and Iranian officials are meeting in Switzerland for a second round of negotiations over a deal aimed at curbing Tehran’s nuclear program and averting war.

item.title: Family Honors Navalny At Moscow Grave On Second Death Anniversary
item.description: Dozens gathered at a Moscow cemetery to pay tribute to Russian opposition leader Aleksei Navalny on the second anniversary of his death. His mother, Lyudmila Navalnaya, laid flowers at his grave, joined by diplomats from several European countries.

item.title: The 9 Lives Of A Frontline Ukrainian Aid Worker
item.description: Yevhen Tkachov, an aid worker with the NGO Proliska, has spent years helping Ukrainians evacuate from war-torn towns and villages. He's had more narrow escapes from enemy fire than he can count and has caught some harrowing scenes on camera as drones and missiles hit nearby.

item.title: Hague War Crimes Trial Casts Shadow Over Kosovo's 18th Birthday Celebrations
item.description: The anniversary of Kosovo's declaration of independence is being overshadowed by the trial of the man who proclaimed it, former President Hashim Thaci, and in particular by the prosecution's request for a 45-year prison sentence.
